title: Mset (staff)
body:
Syntax: mset create <vnum> <name>  |  mset <vnum> <field> <value>  |  mset spawn <vnum> <room>  |  mset list
        mset fields [mob|player]  |  mset <vnum> <field> (show current value and options)

Description: Creates and edits mob prototypes field by field -- level, stats, damage dice, flags, shop/gambler/teacher fields, mob programs, and more. MSET <vnum> SHOPOPEN 8 and SHOPCLOSE 20 schedule an NPC merchant (0-23 world hours). MSET <vnum> GATE <room vnum> <direction> attaches a guard to an existing door; GATEOPEN 6 and GATECLOSE 18 set its daily shift. GATE OFF disables it. MSET FIELDS lists grouped mob fields; MSET FIELDS PLAYER lists player fields. Use MSET <vnum> FLAGS Wander for mob flags. Field names can be typed without underscores; older names still work. Use MSTAT <vnum> to review a prototype.

&D(Staff only.)&x

Date: 2026-08-17

MSET <mob vnum> FLAGS ShopGeneral / ShopWeapons / ShopBlacksmith / ShopFood / ShopMining / ShopFarming / ShopLumberjack / ShopGemcutter / ShopPawnshop. This single flag sets the entire shop specialty and automatically enables the Shopkeeper role. Choosing another specialty replaces the previous one; there is never more than one active. MSET <vnum> FLAGS Shopkeeper creates a general/custom merchant. MSET <vnum> FLAGS -ShopMining removes only that specialty, leaving the shopkeeper as a general merchant. MSET <vnum> FLAGS -Shopkeeper removes the merchant role and all specialties. Merchant role and specialty are controlled exclusively by mob flags. Use MSET ADDITEM <mob vnum> <item vnum> to stock shops; generic Shopkeeper mobs may still specify SHOPBUYSCATEGORIES for custom categories. Trading hours and persistent pawnshop stock are unchanged.

With no flag name, MSET <vnum> FLAGS displays all available flags and the current selections. Prefix - to remove a flag.
